verdict.rationale: Nitrokey ships a documented CLI/SDK (nitropy, pynitrokey) that lets scripts/agents drive the hardware token programmatically, confirmed by runtime probes showing it installs and runs from PyPI. However, there is no REST/OpenAPI-style public API — explicit probes for llms.txt, docs-md, and openapi.json all 404 — so an AI agent has no network-callable documented API, only a local CLI/SDK. Missing for 10: a documented HTTP/OpenAPI public API, machine-readable API spec, and any AI-agent-specific integration guidance.
